_comment: Pending one-off requests for the next schedule generation. Each entry applies to a single 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) and is cleared automatically by generate_schedule.py once that date has been generated -- the written .txt schedule is the permanent record after that. Types: 'day_off' (force this person off that day, ahead of the normal rotation) and 'location_lock' (if working, restrict them to one location: MAIN/MARFORI/MINTAL/TORIL/SASA/BISTRO). For multi-day leave, use roster.json's on_leave instead.
